name: Banded Monster Walk
steps: Place a mini band just above your knees or around your ankles.
Stand with feet shoulder width so the band is tight.
Bend your knees slightly into a quarter squat.
Take small steps forward diagonally, keeping tension on the band.
Walk the same number of steps backward to the start.
cues: Stay low in a quarter squat
Knees push out against the band

common_mistakes.fix: Stay in a quarter squat throughout
Keep feet apart so the band stays tight
Push knees outward against the band
